transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to finalize the public opening plan for "Tidal Memory" in Gallery 4 — it's scheduled for October 12 through October 15. The current draft has online-connected playback, eight visitor stations, 15-minute sessions, and a 5:00 PM public opening on October 12. As you all know, our daily production huddle includes a routine final check where rights, technical, accessibility, and artist representatives can state any conditions that need to be added before I approve this plan. So let's go through it — please share any conditions or concerns from your respective areas.

transcript.text: I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning, and there are three conditions we must add to the exhibition plan before it can be approved. First, Tidal Memory may be exhibited only through offline local playback — so the current draft's online-connected playback needs to be changed. Second, visitors may not photograph or record the installation. Third, the exhibition must use the exact credit line: 'Music licensed from Harborlight Editions.' The license arrived after the exhibition packet was circulated, which is why the packet hasn't been updated yet.
